Xech- Inflate Cordless Tyre Inflator

Stay ready for any inflation task with the Inflate Cordless Tyre Inflator by XECH, the perfect companion for your car, bike, motorcycle, and more. This portable and rechargeable auto air pump is designed for quick, efficient inflation with a powerful 150 PSI capability. The digital display ensures easy monitoring, while the auto cut-off feature provides safe, precise inflation. With multiple nozzles and a built-in LED flashlight, it’s the ideal tool for both everyday and emergencies. The Type C charging port ensures fast, reliable power on the go, making Inflate a must-have for your car accessories collection.

  • Powerful Cordless Tyre Inflator by XECH :- The XECH Cordless Tyre Inflator offers quick, efficient inflation up to 150 PSI. Designed for cars, bikes, motorcycles, and more, it’s your go-to solution for everyday and emergency inflations.
  • Rechargeable inflator for cars, bikes, and more:- The XECH Cordless Tyre Inflator offers ultimate convenience with its rechargeable battery, making inflating tires on cars, bikes, and more completely hassle-free, anytime and anywhere.
  • High-Performance Fast Inflation:- Experience super-fast inflation with up to 150 PSI. Preset your desired pressure, and let the inflator handle the rest. Recharge quickly with the USB-C port for constant readiness.
  • Smart Display with Cooling System:- The digital display provides precise pressure readings for easy monitoring, while the inbuilt cooling fan ensures optimal performance even during extended use, preventing overheating.:- Perfect for cars, bikes, motorcycles, and more
  • With up to 150 PSI of power, this inflator easily handles a range of vehicle tires, from cars to bicycles and motorcycles. Efficient, reliable performance for all your inflating needs.:- Versatile Attachments for All This inflator comes with multiple attachments and hoses for easy inflation of car tires, bike tires, sports balls, and other inflatables. Enjoy seamless versatility for all your needs.
  • Automatic shut-off at preset pressure:- The IntelliStop feature ensures safe inflation by automatically stopping once the preset pressure is reached. Prevents over inflation, protecting your tires and inflatables with precision.
  • Small size with impressive 150 PSI power:- Despite its compact design, this inflator packs a punch with 150 PSI capability. Perfect for easy storage and powerful enough to handle all your inflation needs efficiently.
  • Simple steps for cars, bikes, and more:- Using the XECH cordless inflator is effortless: select the mode, attach the nozzle, set your desired pressure, and let it inflate. Ideal for cars, bikes, and other inflatables.
  • Built-In Flashlight for Safety:- The built-in flashlight ensures you can inflate tires and inflatables safely in low light or dark conditions. Perfect for roadside emergencies and nighttime use, enhancing visibility and convenience.
  • Emergency SOS Light Feature:- The built-in emergency SOS light provides crucial signaling during roadside emergencies. Easily switch to SOS mode for enhanced safety and visibility in critical situations.
